 LABONITA VIETNAM and its journey of spreading the spirit of gentle skincare.
 As Korean beauty trends increasingly focus on moisturizing, restoring, and maintaining healthy skin, LABONITA chooses to develop gentle skincare solutions that address the practical needs of consumers. With the message "Korean-style moisturizing – Gentle on the skin," the brand is gradually bringing the spirit of Korean skincare closer to Vietnamese women.
 Báo Tiền Phong • 05/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 From Korea to Vietnam: The development journey of LABONITA
 LABONITA is a skincare brand from South Korea, established in 2005 with products manufactured by Charmzone NC1. After a period of development, the brand gradually expanded its operations to more than 10 countries, including the United States, Canada, Japan, China, and Thailand ...
 In June 2022, LABONITA officially launched in the Vietnamese market, marking a significant step in the brand's development in Southeast Asia. Distribution in Vietnam is currently handled by Lam Chau Beauty International Co., Ltd. The brand is gradually expanding its product range and developing its distribution network to bring Korean skincare solutions closer to Vietnamese consumers.
 With the message "Korean-style moisturizing – Soothing for the skin," LABONITA focuses on developing product lines that moisturize, soothe, and support the restoration of the skin's protective barrier. This is also the guiding principle throughout its journey of accompanying Vietnamese consumers, aiming to nourish skin that is moisturized, balanced, and healthy. 
 The journey of LABONITA's development from South Korea to the Vietnamese market. LABONITA and its approach to gentle skincare, focusing on moisturizing and supporting skin recovery.
 In Vietnam, the humid tropical climate, changing weather, and the impacts of urban environments and lifestyle habits can cause skin to become dry, tight, dehydrated, or easily irritated. This makes moisturizing and caring for the skin's protective barrier a crucial need in daily skincare routines.
 Recognizing this need, LABONITA has developed a diverse range of cosmetics, from gentle cleansing and moisturizing to soothing and restorative products. Instead of focusing on immediate results, the brand aims for sustainable skincare, emphasizing ingredients such as Hyaluronic Acid (HA), Panthenol (B5), Cica, and plant extracts. HA helps maintain moisture, while Panthenol soothes and supports the skin's protective barrier, helping users establish a suitable daily skincare routine. 
 LABONITA aims to provide moisturizing solutions and gentle skincare support, tailored to the needs of Vietnamese consumers. Discover three flagship skincare products from LABONITA.
 You may also like Vital Hyaluronic Acid Serum – Replenishes moisture, maintains supple and smooth skin. 
 Representing LABONITA's moisturizing line, Vital Hyaluronic Acid Serum was developed to meet the needs of replenishing and maintaining skin hydration.
 LABONITA's HA Serum contains a complex of 7 forms of Hyaluronic Acid, including 9,000 ppm of Sodium Hyaluronate, which helps replenish and maintain moisture, leaving skin softer and smoother.
 Panthenol Repair Ampoule – Helps soothe and care for the skin's protective barrier.
 While Hyaluronic Acid focuses on moisturizing needs, Panthenol Repair Ampoule represents LABONITA's line of serums aimed at soothing and supporting skin recovery.
 When skin is prone to irritation or requires intensive care, ingredients like Panthenol and Cica are often considered in skincare routines. This serum combines 5% Panthenol, a 5-Cica complex, and Moisture B, which contains plant-derived ingredients such as aloe vera and lotus root. The formula aims to moisturize, soothe dryness and tightness, and support the skin's protective barrier.
 Vital Panthenol Gel Cleanser – Gentle cleansing with a pH of 5.5
 Besides its serums, LABONITA also emphasizes the cleansing step, a crucial element in maintaining a proper skincare routine.
 Vital Panthenol Gel Cleanser is a gel-based facial cleanser with a pH of 5.5, combining Panthenol with Centella Asiatica and Houttuynia Cordata extracts to remove dirt and sebum while helping to maintain moisture and minimize dryness and tightness after cleansing. 
 LABONITA's three flagship products address the needs of cleansing, moisturizing, and soothing the skin. You may also like LABONITA Vietnam – Spreading the gentle skincare spirit from Korea
 In an increasingly diverse cosmetics market, consumers are not only interested in the effectiveness of products but also pay attention to their origin, ingredients, and suitability for their skin's needs.
 In line with this trend, LABONITA Vietnam's development is guided by the values ​​of Trust, Understanding, Science , and Sustainability. The brand focuses on building a portfolio of skincare products of Korean origin, while also developing a distribution system to provide a more convenient and transparent shopping experience.
 With the message "Korean-style moisturizing – Soothing for the skin," LABONITA Vietnam aims to continue accompanying consumers on their journey to nurture healthy, balanced, and soft skin, making skincare a positive daily habit.

 Unit in Vietnam: Lam Chau Beauty International Co., Ltd.
